items.title: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum in Historic $115 Billion Deal
items.summary: Marvell Technology agreed to buy Lumentum Holdings at an enterprise value of $115 billion, one of the largest technology deals in history. The all-stock deal is a bet on optical networking, increasingly used in AI data centers amid runaway AI infrastructure spending.
items.why_it_matters: It shows how much capital is still flowing into AI data-center hardware even as investors grow nervous about the broader AI trade.

items.title: Anthropic reports $17 billion in Q3 revenue, purchase commitments of $895.4 billion in revised S-1
items.summary: Anthropic's revised S-1 filing ahead of its IPO discloses Q3 revenue of $17 billion and purchase commitments of $895.4 billion. The initial S-1 filed the week before only included financials through the first half of the year.
items.why_it_matters: The filing gives investors their first full look at Anthropic's revenue growth and the scale of its compute spending commitments as it heads toward a public listing.

items.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
items.summary: OpenAI announced the Grid Protectors Program, working with utilities to help future compute campuses support grid reliability and protect consumer electricity costs. The company says it will pilot the program at an upcoming data center in Effingham County, Georgia, freeing up to 1,000 megawatts of power during extreme weather or emergencies.
items.why_it_matters: It's a direct response to growing public opposition to AI data centers straining local power grids and electricity prices.

items.title: Nasdaq 100 Enters Correction as Megacap Results Amplify AI Fears
items.summary: The Nasdaq 100 tumbled into a correction as investors turned increasingly pessimistic about Big Tech and the AI trade following a batch of megacap earnings. The move adds to a string of AI-bubble warnings from strategists this week.
items.why_it_matters: A correction in the index most exposed to AI stocks is a concrete sign that market confidence in the AI spending boom is cracking.

items.title: LifeVal
items.summary: OpenAI introduced LifeVal, a new benchmark measuring how well AI helps people complete everyday tasks, from finding childcare to managing finances and government paperwork.
items.why_it_matters: Benchmarks like this push the industry to measure AI usefulness on real-world life tasks rather than abstract reasoning tests alone.

items.title: DeepSeek Boosts AI Agent Offering With New Creator Mode
items.summary: DeepSeek unveiled a new Creator Mode letting users quickly build custom plugins to tackle complex tasks, the latest move by the Chinese lab to strengthen its AI agent offerings.
items.why_it_matters: It shows DeepSeek continuing to push into agentic AI tooling, an area where it competes directly with Western labs.

items.title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
items.summary: 42AI emerged from stealth with $62.5 million in funding and a world model it says can predict what a person is about to do, even in a completely new situation.
items.why_it_matters: World models that claim to anticipate human action are an ambitious bet within the broader world-model research race.

items.title: Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features
items.summary: A Wired investigation found roughly 400 apps and websites linked to Chinese-language developers that present themselves as ordinary AI tools but contain hidden features for generating violent or sexually abusive deepfake images and video.
items.why_it_matters: It highlights a large, hidden ecosystem of AI tools built specifically to create non-consensual abusive content.

items.title: OpenAI deepens Abu Dhabi foothold as Sam Altman inks deals spanning energy, government and investment
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman signed four agreements in Abu Dhabi spanning energy, government and investment, meeting with the emirate's crown prince as OpenAI deepens its presence in the UAE.
items.why_it_matters: It extends OpenAI's push to secure energy and capital from Gulf states to fund its compute buildout.

items.title: Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins win Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for work in AI-enabled antibiotic discovery
items.summary: MIT professors Regina Barzilay and Jim Collins won the Pritzker Prize for AI and Science Research Excellence for identifying the first AI-discovered antibiotic, a milestone widely recognized in AI-driven drug discovery.
items.why_it_matters: It recognizes one of the clearest real-world payoffs so far of applying AI to scientific discovery.
